history.body: Hi, I came across Pearl Residences while browsing around Seberang Jaya. What’s the general price range there? I’m just trying to get a feel for the area and options.

The pricing reference I have shows indicative base prices around RM328k–RM358k. That’s before any unit-specific car-park costs or current package, so it may not reflect today’s final price. I’ll get the latest general range confirmed for you. Are you mainly comparing homes for your own stay or as an investment?

Probably for my own stay if I do end up buying, but I’m still comparing areas and haven’t made up my mind. Is there a smaller unit option, and would its price be closer to the lower end of that range?

For Phase 1, the residential units are all Type A: 900 sq ft, with 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony, so there isn’t a smaller layout in this phase. The earlier RM328k–RM358k range was indicative base pricing, and the lower end isn’t specifically tied to a smaller unit; pricing varies by unit category and car-park configuration. The latest general price and package confirmation is still pending, so I can’t confirm today’s starting figure yet. Would 900 sq ft still be a size you’d consider, or are you specifically looking for something smaller?
